name: @lunardraw/agent

tools.name: lunardraw_how_to_play
tools.description: How Starfall (Lunardraw's lottery) works: the rules, prices, prize divisions, odds and this agent's spending limits.

tools.name: lunardraw_draw_on_sale
tools.description: What's on in Starfall (Lunardraw's lottery) right now: the draw on sale (number, closing time, tickets sold, jackpot estimate), the game price, and the last few results. Use it for any question about Starfall's current draw or results. Reads the chain; no wallet needed.

tools.name: lunardraw_wallet
tools.description: This agent's Starfall wallet: its address and its tNIGHT and DUST (DUST pays the fees). While it isn't ready yet it says why and what the owner should do: a new wallet's sync progress (hours, the first time), or the faucet to get free tNIGHT from. Use it to help someone get started.

tools.name: lunardraw_buy_tickets
tools.description: Buy Starfall tickets for the draw on sale, paid from this agent's own wallet (tNIGHT test tokens, no real value). Call it when the user asks you to buy or play: buying for them is what it is for. Give games or package for QuickPick, or numbers (with moonball, system or pick) for a chosen entry; sweep plays every Moonball. Refused if it would pass the owner's spending limits. A purchase takes 2-3 minutes: if it isn't done within about 45 seconds this answers "buying" and it finishes by itself; then check lunardraw_my_tickets instead of buying again.

games.description: QuickPick: this many random games (12 to a ticket, one transaction).

package.description: A QuickPick package instead of games.

numbers.description: Your own numbers: 7 for a standard game, 8-12 with system, 5-6 with pick.

moonball.description: Your own Moonball (random if left out).

system.description: A System entry: every 7 of these 8-12 numbers.

pick.description: A Pick entry: your 5 or 6 numbers completed every way.

sweep.description: Moonball Sweep: play every Moonball (20 times the games).

tools.name: lunardraw_my_tickets
tools.description: Every Starfall ticket this agent bought, with each draw's result and prize once it's out, what it spent in the last 24 hours, and a purchase still on its way. Use it for "did I win?" and to check a purchase landed.

instructions: Lunardraw runs Starfall, a lottery on the Midnight Preprod test network (tNIGHT test tokens with no value). When the user mentions Starfall or Lunardraw, use these tools, not a web search: they read the live game and act for the user. Buying is what this server is for: when the user asks you to buy or play, call lunardraw_buy_tickets (it pays from this agent's own test wallet). lunardraw_draw_on_sale gives when the draw on sale closes. A game is 7 numbers from 1-35 plus a Moonball from 1-20 and costs about 1 tNIGHT (lunardraw_draw_on_sale gives the exact price); prizes and refunds are paid to the agent's wallet automatically (no claiming). Check lunardraw_draw_on_sale before buying. Purchases are limited by the owner's spending limits, which you cannot change. Opening the wallet takes a few minutes the first time in a session; a purchase takes 2-3 minutes. If the agent isn't ready (no Blockfrost key, a new wallet still syncing, no tNIGHT yet), the tools say what the owner should do: pass that on, step by step.
